title: These sheets are soft and wash well.
text:
These sheets are soft and wash well.. I washed the sheets twice and didn't notice any piling. they are soft and don't wrinkle out of the dryer.

The comforter was not washed, but I did toss it in the dryer and it did well. I will wash it later to see if it bunches up. I just wanted to see how it looks on the bed just in case the machine messes it up.
